annotations.title: Read a GeoThought project with this agent

description: Start reading a GeoThought project with THIS agent instead of GeoThought's own model: its documents that have no answer yet are queued for you, and the answers you give stay with the project. Optional `schemas` (names) to ask only some of its schemas' questions, `documents` (report keys such as A24950) to read only some, `limit` to queue only that many documents. Then call geothought_next_document. Reading costs your model's tokens: roughly 10k-30k input tokens a document for a schema of a few dozen questions.
name: geothought_start_agent_reading
title: Read a GeoThought project with this agent
